sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使在黑胶唱片时代的夜店里做DJ时，你每晚也会带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成这样一个充满活力的、由美丽50年历史艺术品组成的临时快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, Attorney General Jeff Sessions has recused himself from any investigation into Russia's interference in the presidential campaign.
sentences.zh: 今天，司法部长杰夫·塞申斯已申请回避任何关于俄罗斯干预总统竞选的调查。

sentences.en: What was Sessions doing meeting with the Russian ambassador two months before election day?
sentences.zh: 塞申斯在选举日前两个月会见俄罗斯大使究竟是为了什么？

sentences.en: And who is this mysterious Russian ambassador who is causing so much trouble for not one, but two senior officials in the Trump White House?
sentences.zh: 这位给特朗普白宫里不仅一位、而是两位高级官员制造如此大麻烦的神秘俄罗斯大使又是何许人也？

sentences.en: It's Friday, March 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月3日，星期五。

sentences.en: Just to clear up any confusion over this, could you just explain a little bit about the September 8th meeting, who on your staff was there,
sentences.zh: 为了澄清对此事的任何混淆，您能否简单解释一下9月8日的会议，您手下的哪些人在场，

sentences.en: and what was discussed with the Russian ambassador?
sentences.zh: 以及与俄罗斯大使讨论了什么？

sentences.en: The Russian ambassador apparently sent a staffer to my office, I did not see him, and asked for a meeting, as so many of the ambassadors were doing.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯大使显然派了一名工作人员到我的办公室，我没有见他，并像许多大使那样要求会面。

sentences.en: And we set up a time, as we did, as we normally did, and what we met with him.
sentences.zh: 我们安排了一个时间，就像我们平时所做的那样，然后我们与他会面了。

sentences.en: That's the account that Attorney General Jeff Sessions gave on Thursday of how it was he came to meet with the Russian ambassador,
sentences.zh: 这是司法部长杰夫·塞申斯周四给出的解释，说明他是如何在2016年9月8日与俄罗斯大使

sentences.en: Sergey Kassilyak, on September 8th, 2016.
sentences.zh: 谢尔盖·基斯利亚克会面的。

sentences.en: But the reason for that meeting, between Sessions, who was then a senator from Alabama, and Kassilyak, is now the subject of intense scrutiny,
sentences.zh: 但塞申斯（当时他是来自阿拉巴马州的参议员）与基斯利亚克会面的原因，现在成为了严密审视的主题，

sentences.en: since the fact of it was revealed earlier this week.
sentences.zh: 因为这件事在本周早些时候被曝光了。

sentences.en: For years, I've developed a lot of friendships.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我结交了许多友谊。

sentences.en: And some people are good, and some people are okay, and some people are lousy, right?
sentences.zh: 有些人很好，有些人还可以，有些人很糟糕，对吧？

sentences.en: So at this point,
sentences.zh: 所以在这一点上，

sentences.en: Sessions has very, very publicly become...
sentences.zh: 塞申斯非常公开地成为了……

sentences.en: My colleague, Matthew Rosenberg, has been reporting on the story.
sentences.zh: 我的同事马修·罗森伯格一直在报道这个故事。

sentences.en: ...one of Donald Trump's most prominent surrogates on the campaign trail.
sentences.zh: ……唐纳德·特朗普在竞选活动中最突出的代理人之一。

sentences.en: I have a man who is respected by everybody here, greatly respected.
sentences.zh: 我有一个备受这里所有人尊敬、且受到高度尊敬的人。

sentences.en: Trump did not have a lot of prominent Republicans early to his cause.
sentences.zh: 特朗普在早期并没有获得许多知名共和党人的支持。

sentences.en: Sessions was one of the earlieSt.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯是最早的支持者之一。

sentences.en: Senator Jeff Sessions!
sentences.zh: 参议员杰夫·塞申斯！

sentences.en: So he's endorsed him?
sentences.zh: 所以他背书了他？

sentences.en: He's endorsed him, he's out speaking for him.
sentences.zh: 他背书了他，他一直在为他公开演讲。

sentences.en: I told Donald Trump, this isn't a campaign, this is a movement.
sentences.zh: 我告诉唐纳德·特朗普，这不是一场竞选，这是一场运动。

sentences.en: He's been advising Trump on foreign policy since March.
sentences.zh: 他自3月以来一直就外交政策向特朗普提供建议。

sentences.en: The American people are not happy with their government.
sentences.zh: 美国人民对他们的政府并不满意。

sentences.en: So look, once that happens, ambassadors line up to meet with you, because they want to get in with the next administration.
sentences.zh: 所以你看，一旦发生这种情况，大使们就会排队与你见面，因为他们想打入下一届政府内部。

sentences.en: So now we understand why the ambassador would want to meet with Sessions, but why would Sessions want to meet with the Russian ambassador?
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们明白为什么大使想见塞申斯了，但塞申斯为什么想见俄罗斯大使？

sentences.en: That's a lot less clear.
sentences.zh: 这一点远没有那么清晰。

sentences.en: You know, Sessions has said as part of his duties, the Armed Services Committee, he was having the meeting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，塞申斯曾表示，作为军事委员会职责的一部分，他在举行那次会面。

sentences.en: That's not a very common thing for people on the Armed Services Committee to do to meet with the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 军事委员会的成员去会见俄罗斯大使并不是一件很常见的事。

sentences.en: They do meet with a lot of ambassadors from allies with which we have close military relationships.
sentences.zh: 他们确实会见许多与我们有紧密军事关系的盟国的大使。

sentences.en: Perhaps, you know, our NATO allies,
sentences.zh: 也许，你知道，我们的北约盟国，

sentences.en: Japan, Israel.
sentences.zh: 日本，以色列。

sentences.en: For the Russians, it's different.
sentences.zh: 对俄罗斯人来说，情况则不同。

sentences.en: It's a much more difficult relationship.
sentences.zh: 这是一段困难得多的关系。

sentences.en: And the Washington Post and their reporting, they queried 20 different members of the Armed Services Committee, none of whom said they'd had any meetings
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》在他们的报道中查询了军事委员会的20位不同成员，没有一个人说他们去年曾与

sentences.en: with the Russian ambassador last year.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯大使有过任何会面。

sentences.en: Is there anything inherently wrong with a senator, even a campaign advisor to a president having this kind of a meeting?
sentences.zh: 参议员，甚至是总统的竞选顾问，进行这种会面有什么本质上的不对吗？

sentences.en: Depends on what went on in the meeting.
sentences.zh: 这取决于会面上发生了什么。

sentences.en: So there's no simple answer on that.
sentences.zh: 所以对此没有简单的答案。

sentences.en: And that's, I think, one of the problems here is that the meeting in itself is no big deal.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是这里的问题之一，即会面本身并不是什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: The fact that you don't want to talk about it, that you try and hide it, that it's only months later, does it come out, you had the meeting,
sentences.zh: 问题在于你不想谈论它，你试图掩盖它，直到几个月后才被曝出你开过会，

sentences.en: raises questions about what went on in that meeting.
sentences.zh: 这就引发了关于那场会上发生了什么的疑问。

sentences.en: What else happened on September 8th, the day of this meeting?
sentences.zh: 9月8日这一天，也就是会面当天，还发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, I mean, there was a lot in the air on that day.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，那天空气中弥漫着很多东西。

sentences.en: You've got Clinton giving her first press conference in weeks at that point.
sentences.zh: 你当时看到克林顿在几周内首次举行新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Bizarrely, once again, he praised Russia's strongman, Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，他再次赞扬了俄罗斯的强人弗拉基米尔·普京。

sentences.en: And really about the Putin-Trump kind of accusations, alleging that there was this collusion, there's something untoward here, and that, you know, people need to know about it.
sentences.zh: 而且确实是关于普京与特朗普的种种指控，声称存在这种勾结，这里面有不正当的事情，而且，你知道，人们需要了解它。

sentences.en: Even taking the astonishing step of suggesting that he prefers the Russian president to our American president.
sentences.zh: 甚至采取了令人震惊的举动，暗示他更喜欢俄罗斯总统而不是我们的美国总统。

sentences.en: And then you've also got Trump going on Russia today.
sentences.zh: 然后你还看到特朗普上了“今日俄罗斯”。

sentences.en: I don't know who hacked.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是谁黑的。

sentences.en: I'm not sure who, I mean, you tell me who hacked, who did the hacking, but I have an absolute...
sentences.zh: 我不确定是谁，我的意思是，你告诉我谁黑的，谁进行了黑客攻击，但我绝对……

sentences.en: The Russian network that the American intelligence community believes is entirely a Kremlin-backed propaganda network.
sentences.zh: 美国情报界认为这是一个完全由克里姆林宫支持的宣传网络的俄罗斯电视网。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: intelligence and law enforcement agencies reportedly are investigating whether Russia launched the covert operation to disrupt the 2016 election.
sentences.zh: 的情报和执法机构据报道正在调查俄罗斯是否发起了一项秘密行动来破坏2016年大选。

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I think it's probably unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能不太可能。

sentences.en: I think maybe the Democrats are putting that out.
sentences.zh: 我想也许是民主党人放出的风声。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: But...
sentences.zh: 但是……

sentences.en: There is a lot in the ether about the Trump-Russia questions.
sentences.zh: 关于特朗普与俄罗斯的问题，空中弥漫着许多传言。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So the intelligence community is starting to pick up this Russian interference.
sentences.zh: 所以情报界开始察觉到这种俄罗斯的干预。

sentences.en: What do they know by or around September 8th, the day of this meeting?
sentences.zh: 在9月8日前后，即会面当天，他们都知道些什么？

sentences.en: September is sort of a crucial month in all this, and I'm going to step back for a second here.
sentences.zh: 对这一切来说，9月可以说是至关重要的一个月，我在这里先退一步讲。

sentences.en: You start in the spring into the summer where you've got different pieces of the intelligence community and the government picking up noises.
sentences.zh: 从春季到夏季，你开始发现情报界和政府的不同部门捕捉到了各种风声。

sentences.en: Then you get...
sentences.zh: 然后你发现……

sentences.en: We have got an extraordinary development occurring as we're talking.
sentences.zh: 就在我们谈话的时候，发生了一个非同寻常的进展。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks has done a Friday document dump.
sentences.zh: 维基解密在周五进行了一次文件大倾倒。

sentences.en: WikiLeaks is pushing out emails that have been hacked and stolen from the DNC.
sentences.zh: 维基解密正在公布从民主党全国委员会（DNC）被黑客攻击和窃取的电子邮件。

sentences.en: They suggest that DNC employees have plotted in many ways to undercut and undermine Senator Sanders during the primary.
sentences.zh: 这些邮件表明DNC员工在初选期间曾以多种方式密谋削弱和破坏桑德斯参议员。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of embarrassing revelations in there.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多令人尴尬的爆料。

sentences.en: So you need both a public and a private position.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要同时拥有公开和私下的立场。

sentences.en: Effectively acknowledging everything she says could potentially be the absolute inverse of what she means.
sentences.zh: 实际上承认她所说的每一句话可能都与她的真实意图完全相反。

sentences.en: And to old Russia hands in the government, it started to look like this old dirty trick known as kompromat.
sentences.zh: 对于政府中的老俄罗斯通来说，这开始看起来像是一种被称为“黑材料”（kompromat）的肮脏老把戏。

sentences.en: It started the Soviets.
sentences.zh: 它始于苏联时期。

sentences.en: Putin, of course, was a KGB guy.
sentences.zh: 普京当然是个克格勃出身。

sentences.en: And it's this idea that you take damaging material you have against somebody, maybe a videotape of them with a prostitute or something, and you put it out there to destroy them.
sentences.zh: 这个概念就是，你利用你掌握的对某人具有破坏性的材料，比如他们与妓女在一起的录像带什么的，然后把它放出去以摧毁他们。

sentences.en: And that's what they started to fear what was going on here.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们开始担心这里正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: But it's not really clear exactly what's going on.
sentences.zh: 但目前还不十分清楚究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: The White House is kind of hesitant to get involved.
sentences.zh: 白宫有点犹豫要不要介入。

sentences.en: They're like, oh, what is this?
sentences.zh: 他们觉得，哦，这是什么？

sentences.en: We don't really know.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道。

sentences.en: But in September is when you start getting cyber attacks against state electoral systems, probing their defenses, sucking up voter rolls.
sentences.zh: 但在9月，你开始遭受针对各州选举系统的网络攻击，探测其防御系统，搜集选民名册。

sentences.en: That's also presumed to be Russian by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这也是美国政府假定为俄罗斯所为的。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: Once you start getting those attacks on the electoral system, then it's like, okay, maybe they think they really can disrupt the election
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始对选举系统发动那些攻击，就会觉得，好吧，也许他们真的认为自己可以扰乱选举，

sentences.en: or at least raise doubts in the public's mind about it.
sentences.zh: 或者至少在公众心中对此产生怀疑。

sentences.en: How much of this would Senator Jeff Sessions have known about and understood?
sentences.zh: 参议员杰夫·塞申斯对其中的多少事情有所了解和理解？

sentences.en: There's no way he could not have known that the questions were out there, that people were talking about it.
sentences.zh: 他不可能不知道外面有这些疑问，人们正在议论纷纷。

sentences.en: I mean, we'd been running front-page stories about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们一直在刊登关于它的头版头条。

sentences.en: I think in July we may have had one.
sentences.zh: 我想我们在7月可能就登过一篇。

sentences.en: This was something that was in the news people were talking about.
sentences.zh: 这是新闻里正在发生、人们正在谈论的事情。

sentences.en: And so you're having this meeting amid all this, and you know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 所以你在这一切当中进行着这次会面，并且你很清楚发生了什么。

sentences.en: If he knows this, and given he's involved with the Trump campaign himself at this moment, why would he have taken this meeting?
sentences.zh: 如果他知道这一点，考虑到他此时正参与特朗普的竞选活动，他为什么还要接受这次会面？

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: I mean, maybe they just were really just having a polite discussion, just chatting it up and seeing where things could go.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，也许他们真的只是在进行一场礼貌的讨论，只是闲聊并看看事情会朝什么方向发展。

sentences.en: But there may be information about that meeting.
sentences.zh: 但可能存在关于那次会面的信息。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: intelligence monitors communications among Russian officials, and I think it's pretty safe to assume that they're doing their best
sentences.zh: 情报部门监控着俄罗斯官员之间的通讯，我认为可以很安全地推测他们正在尽最大努力

sentences.en: to listen in on the Russian ambassador talking to his colleagues back in Moscow, look at the cables he's sending back to Moscow.
sentences.zh: 窃听俄罗斯大使与莫斯科同事的谈话，查看他发回莫斯科的电报。

sentences.en: And if he described that meeting at all, they will at least have that much.
sentences.zh: 如果他哪怕稍微描述过那次会面，他们至少会掌握那么多信息。

sentences.en: But there may be some insight there.
sentences.zh: 但其中可能会有一些洞见。

sentences.en: We just don't know it, and honestly, it's incredibly classified if it exists.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道，老实说，如果真的存在的话，那是高度机密的。

sentences.en: We may never actually see it.
sentences.zh: 我们可能永远也见不到它。

sentences.en: All right, so Trump defeats Hillary Clinton, and he wins the presidential election.
sentences.zh: 好吧，特朗普击败了希拉里·克林顿，赢得了总统大选。

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions is asked to become the U.S.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯被邀请担任美国

sentences.en: Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 司法部长。

sentences.en: You swear that the testimony you're about to give before this committee will be the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth, so help you God.
sentences.zh: 你发誓你在本委员会面前将要提供的证言将是事实，全部的事实，除了事实别无其他，愿上帝帮助你。

sentences.en: And during his confirmation hearing, he's asked a question by Senator Al Franken of Minnesota.
sentences.zh: 在听证会期间，明尼苏达州参议员阿尔·弗兰肯向他提出一个问题。

sentences.en: If there is any evidence that anyone affiliated with the Trump campaign communicated with the Russian government in the course of this campaign, what will you do?
sentences.zh: 如果有任何证据表明任何与特朗普竞选团队有关联的人在本次竞选过程中与俄罗斯政府进行了沟通，你将怎么做？

sentences.en: Senator Franken, I'm not aware of any of those activities.
sentences.zh: 弗兰肯参议员，我不知道有任何此类活动。

sentences.en: I have been called a surrogate at a time or two in that campaign, and I did not have communications with the Russians, and I'm unable to comment on it.
sentences.zh: 在那次竞选中，我曾一两次被称为代理人，我没有与俄罗斯人进行过沟通，对此我无法置评。

sentences.en: Was that answer from Sessions honest?
sentences.zh: 塞申斯的这个回答诚实吗？

sentences.en: In a way, yes, but in a way, no.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说是，但从某种意义上说又不是。

sentences.en: I mean, the excuse that we've now gotten, now that we know there was a contact, has been, well, they asked me if there were contacts about the campaign thing,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，既然我们知道有过接触，我们现在得到的借口一直是，好吧，他们问我的是否有关于竞选事务的接触，

sentences.en: and I wasn't meeting with him in my capacity as part of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 而我并不是以参与竞选的身份去见他的。

sentences.en: That seems awfully lawyerly.
sentences.zh: 这听起来太像律师的诡辩了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the kind of thing my children do to get out of something, or that's Bill Clinton debating what is sexual intercourse, basically.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那就像我的孩子们为了逃避某事而做的事情，或者基本上就像比尔·克林顿在争论什么是性交一样。

sentences.en: It depends upon what the meaning of the word is.
sentences.zh: 这取决于“是”这个词的含义是什么。

sentences.en: And here's the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键是这样的。

sentences.en: Ambassadors are lining up to see you if you're Jeff Sessions because of your association with the campaign, not for other reasons.
sentences.zh: 如果你是杰夫·塞申斯，大使们会因为你与竞选团队的关联而排队见你，而不是出于其他原因。

sentences.en: That's why people want to see you.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们想要见你的原因。

sentences.en: So for Sessions to kind of go out of his way to say, oh, well, we weren't talking about that, it's just, okay, sure, maybe, but then what were you talking about?
sentences.zh: 所以塞申斯特意说，哦，好吧，我们没有谈论那个，这就让人觉得，好吧，当然，也许吧，但你们当时到底在谈什么？

sentences.en: So this is all starting to sound a lot like a phone call that, Matt, we talked to you about on this show a few weeks ago, and it involved the exact same Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切开始听起来很像几周前我们在节目中跟你讨论过的一通电话，马特，而且涉及的正是同一个俄罗斯大使。

sentences.en: Yeah, he was talking to Michael Flynn, who served for 25 days as Trump's national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 是的，他当时在和迈克尔·弗林交谈，弗林曾担任了25天的特朗普国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: When news of those phone calls first emerged later in January, the White House just said, eh, they were just talking about logistics, nothing to look at here, move along.
sentences.zh: 当这些电话的消息在1月晚些时候首次传出时，白宫只是说，呃，他们只是在谈论后勤事务，没什么好看的，大家散了吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, a few weeks after that, it emerged that Flynn had lied to Vice President Pence about what was said on those calls.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在那之后的几周里，爆出弗林曾就这些电话上所说的话向彭斯副总统撒谎。

sentences.en: But there's a bigger issue there that worried many people in the government, which is that if Flynn had actually misled people in the White House
sentences.zh: 但那里有一个让政府中许多人担心的更严重的问题，那就是如果弗林真的就他与基斯利亚克大使交谈的内容

sentences.en: about the content of his conversations with Ambassador Kislyak, that's a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 误导了白宫的人，那可是一件大事。

sentences.en: And the Russians would know that because they were on the other end of that call.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯人会知道这一点，因为他们是那通电话的另一端。

sentences.en: They could then go to Flynn at some point and say, hey, you know, we know you lied.
sentences.zh: 他们随后可以在某个时候去找弗林并说，嘿，你知道的，我们知道你撒谎了。

sentences.en: We know you lied to the Vice President.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你对副总统撒谎了。

sentences.en: So if you don't help us with this, if you don't tell us that, we're going to expose your lie.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你不在这件事上帮我们，如果你不告诉我们这些，我们就要揭穿你的谎言。

sentences.en: And that's the kind of thing that is a huge blackmail risk.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种会带来巨大勒索风险的事情。

sentences.en: That's what they're worried about.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们所担忧的。

sentences.en: Is there a potential, theoretically, for that same problem, for the risk of blackmail here with Sessions and his communications with Kislyak?
sentences.zh: 在这里，塞申斯及其与基斯利亚克的通讯是否存在同样问题的潜力，从理论上讲，是否存在遭受勒索的风险？

sentences.en: Yeah, there are real problems there.
sentences.zh: 是的，那里确实存在真正的问题。

sentences.en: Any kind of secret conversation is going to raise red flags.
sentences.zh: 任何形式的秘密对话都会敲响警钟。

sentences.en: And if they talked about anything that has not been fully disclosed, the Russians know that.
sentences.zh: 如果他们谈论了任何尚未完全公开的事情，俄罗斯人是知道的。

sentences.en: You know, they were part of that conversation and they could use it.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们参与了那场对话，他们本可以利用这一点。

sentences.en: They said that since I had involvement with the campaign, I should not be involved in any campaign investigation.
sentences.zh: 他们说，既然我参与了竞选活动，我就不应该参与任何竞选调查。

sentences.en: I have studied the rules and considered their comments and evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我研究了这些规则，并考虑了他们的意见和评估。

sentences.en: I believe those recommendations are right and juSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为这些建议是正确且公正的。

sentences.en: So now that Sessions has recused himself, is that more or less that?
sentences.zh: 所以既然塞尚已经回避了，事情就这样了吗？

sentences.en: Is this over?
sentences.zh: 这事结束了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, I doubt it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我对此表示怀疑。

sentences.en: You know, there are there.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们就在那里。

sentences.en: The FBI is running investigations into people close to Trump being in touch with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局正在对与特朗普亲近、同俄罗斯人有接触的人展开调查。

sentences.en: There is intelligence collection going on.
sentences.zh: 情报搜集工作正在进行中。

sentences.en: There is a Senate investigation, a House investigation.
sentences.zh: 有参议院调查，也有众议院调查。

sentences.en: People in the Obama administration made a great effort at the end of the administration.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府的人在政府任期结束时做出了巨大努力。

sentences.en: Their final days in office to kind of spread intel around to make sure as many people could see it.
sentences.zh: 在他们任职的最后几天里，四处散播情报，以确保尽可能多的人能看到。

sentences.en: So there couldn't have any kind of cover up.
sentences.zh: 这样就不会发生任何形式的掩盖。

sentences.en: And there's a lot out there.
sentences.zh: 而且外界已经有很多消息了。

sentences.en: And that's what's so curious about all this.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切最奇怪的地方。

sentences.en: It would seem that if you were in the White House, you at this point might want to call for an independent investigation just to get past all this,
sentences.zh: 似乎如果你在白宫，此时此刻你可能会希望要求进行独立调查，以便摆脱这一切，

sentences.en: especially if it is the case that there's nothing to look at here.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果这里根本没有什么可查的话。

sentences.en: You know, and I don't want to say that there's nothing to look at here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我并不是说这里没有什么可查的。

sentences.en: We just don't know that.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不知道这一点。

sentences.en: But it just keeps lingering on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 但这件事却一直在拖延，没完没了。

sentences.en: And you kind of get the feeling, are there going to be more revelations like this?
sentences.zh: 你会有一种感觉，还会有更多这样的爆料吗？

sentences.en: How much more of this is going to have to dribble out?
sentences.zh: 还要有多少这样的消息被一点点挤出来？

sentences.en: It feels like from all the intelligence that Russia's original goal was to help the Trump administration win this election.
sentences.zh: 从所有情报来看，俄罗斯最初的目标似乎是帮助特朗普政府赢得这次选举。

sentences.en: But have they now become the biggest threat to the Trump administration?
sentences.zh: 但他们现在是否成了特朗普政府最大的威胁？

sentences.en: Well, I think that's something really important to keep in mind here, is that the Russians' biggest goal, at least if you ask people who've seen the intel,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为这里有一点非常重要，需要牢记，那就是俄罗斯人的最大目标，至少如果你问那些看过情报的人的话，

sentences.en: seems to have been to disrupt America, to interfere in our elections, to weaken the United States.
sentences.zh: 似乎是扰乱美国、干预我们的选举、削弱美国。

sentences.en: That's the goal here.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里的目标。

sentences.en: And what we've been told is they don't particularly like Trump that much.
sentences.zh: 我们得到的消息是，他们其实并不是那么喜欢特朗普。

sentences.en: They just really disliked Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: 他们只是真的很讨厌希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: You know, the hacker, the kind of hacker community uses a term they call like social hacking, where you're kind of disrupting the society.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，黑客，这种黑客社群使用一个他们称之为社会性黑客的词，也就是你在某种程度上扰乱社会。

sentences.en: And if that was the Russian goal, they seem to be doing not a terrible job at it.
sentences.zh: 如果那是俄罗斯人的目标，他们在这方面做得还算差强人意。

sentences.en: You know, they raise questions throughout the campaign.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们在整个竞选期间不断提出质疑。

sentences.en: They've got the political elite of the country warring with each other over how to handle this Russian issue.
sentences.zh: 他们让这个国家的政治精英们为如何处理这个俄罗斯问题而互相争斗。

sentences.en: They've got stories in the news media talking about it.
sentences.zh: 他们的故事登上了新闻媒体的头条。

sentences.en: And I mean, if the Russians had set out to disrupt and upset America's democracy, they've certainly had some success.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果俄罗斯人着手要扰乱和颠覆美国的民主，他们无疑取得了一些成功。

sentences.en: Matthew, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 马修，非常感谢你。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 自选举以来，对特朗普白宫造成破坏的最具破坏性的力量

sentences.zh: 谢尔盖·基斯利亚克是谁？

sentences.zh: 嗯，谢尔盖·基斯利亚克基本上是俄罗斯外交部的一名长期职业外交官。

sentences.en: Well, Sergei Kislyak is a longtime career foreign ministry diplomat, basically, for the Russians.
sentences.zh: 彼得·贝克是我们的首席白宫记者。

sentences.zh: 他的履历一直可以追溯到苏联时代。

sentences.en: He goes back all the way to the Soviet era.
sentences.zh: 他的职业生涯大部分时间都在处理与美国及相关问题。

sentences.zh: 罗纳德·里根时代后期，他就曾在华盛顿的大使馆工作过。

sentences.en: He was here in the Washington embassy during the later part of the Reagan era.
sentences.zh: 苏联解体后，他也是俄罗斯首任驻北约大使。

sentences.en: And he was also the first Russian ambassador to NATO once the Soviet Union fell apart.
sentences.zh: 你在俄罗斯和华盛顿当过很长时间的记者。

sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否见过这个人，他是一个怎样的人？

sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: Yeah, sure.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿处理俄罗斯问题的人都见过谢尔盖·基斯利亚克。

sentences.en: Everybody who deals with Russia issues in Washington has met Sergei Kislyak.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我和妻子常驻莫斯科时，我们在那里就认识他。

sentences.en: We actually knew him, my wife and I, in Moscow when we were based there.
sentences.zh: 他曾一度担任副外长。

sentences.en: He was the deputy foreign minister for a time.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，他是一个老派苏联时代培养出来的俄罗斯外交官，为了适应自己国家不断变化的时代，他重新调整并改变了自己。

sentences.en: And he's, you know, he's an old-school Soviet-era raised Russian diplomat who has readapted himself and changed himself for the changing times in his own country.
sentences.zh: 但他一直以来都是俄罗斯政策和观点非常坚定、甚至好斗的捍卫者。

sentences.en: But he's always been a very, very fierce, even pugnacious advocate for Russia's policy and point of view.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，他与弗拉基米尔·普京并不亲近。

sentences.en: He's not close to Vladimir Putin, as far as we know.
sentences.zh: 但举个例子，当乌克兰干预事件发生时，他会在华盛顿公开露面，

sentences.en: But for instance, when the Ukraine intervention happened, he would be out there in Washington
sentences.zh: 进行强有力的辩护，事实上，即使是对那些认为自己与他很亲近、很友好的人也是如此。

sentences.en: defending it stridently, in fact, to a lot of people who thought they were close to him and friendly with him.
sentences.zh: 他从来不愿为俄罗斯道歉，也不愿表示哪怕一丁点的遗憾。

sentences.en: He was not ever willing to give an apology for Russia or in any way to offer any regrets whatsoever.

sentences.zh: 我认为他们尊重他。

sentences.zh: 你知道的，他不是一个迷人的人。

sentences.en: You know, he's not a charmer.

sentences.en: He's not a schmoozer.

sentences.en: But he showed up.
sentences.zh: 基本上你总能在各种社交圈里看到他。

sentences.en: He would participate in the conversation, basically, that happened in the foreign policy community in Washington.
sentences.zh: 我认为他出来并不是为了赢得朋友。

sentences.zh: 我认为他秉持着俄罗斯的观点，即尊重比友谊更重要。

sentences.en: I think he took the Russian point of view that respect was more important than friendship.
sentences.zh: 所以听到这些真的很有趣，作为驻华盛顿的俄罗斯大使，其经历

sentences.zh: 传统上涉及大量的社交生活，与华盛顿各界人士共进晚餐。

sentences.en: has traditionally involved a lot of kind of social life, dinner parties with D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以我想这并不是一种生来就充满戒心的关系？

sentences.en: types.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实充满戒心。

sentences.zh: 但请记住，过去三位总统中的每一位，都在某个时刻将努力改善与俄罗斯的关系作为自己的使命。

sentences.en: Well, it is wary.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: But keep in mind that each of the last three presidents has, at one point or another, made it his mission to try to make relations with Russia better.
sentences.zh: 布什在早期与普京就这样做了。

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 记住，他看进了普京的灵魂。

sentences.en: Bush did that with Putin early on.

sentences.en: Remember, he saw into his soul.

sentences.en: He said he was going to have a reset.
sentences.zh: 所以在这些思考的时刻，在这些关系更加友好的时刻，显然，

sentences.en: And so during these moments of sort of thought, during these moments of, you know, friendlier relations, obviously,

sentences.en: it's easier for Americans and Russian officials to interact and to have conversations.

sentences.en: And then, of course, something bad happens, like the intervention in Ukraine and things fall apart again.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很显然，作为俄罗斯驻华盛顿这样地方的大使，你显然与该大使馆运作的所有不同机构都有联系。

sentences.en: I mean, obviously, as the ambassador of a Russian embassy in a place like Washington, you obviously are connected to all the different agencies that operate out of that embassy.
